title: 第173章 逃离数据地狱第172章 提取样本与心脏异变
lines: 医圣投影消失后的第三天，意料之外的变故发生了。
那天清晨，林澈正在研究如何将平衡球体的法则应用到疫苗林网络时，突然感到一阵剧烈的心悸。手术刀从手中滑落，刀身黯淡无光，甚至出现了细微的裂纹。
“先生！”赵虎冲进实验室，看到林澈跪倒在地，七窍渗出淡金色的血液——那是法则本源受损的迹象。
白雨和埃塔紧随其后，看到这一幕都惊呆了。
“怎么回事？刚才还好好的！”白雨扶住林澈，用灵能检查他的状态，脸色瞬间惨白，“他的法则结构……在崩溃！”
构成林澈存在的“法则基础”正在瓦解。就像一栋建筑的地基突然变成了流沙，整个结构开始下沉、碎裂。
埃塔用高维扫描仪检查，声音都变了调：“是‘存在锚点侵蚀’！有人……不，有某种力量在从根源上否定他的‘存在合理性’！”
“议会？”赵虎怒目圆睁。
“不，这手法……”埃塔快速分析着侵蚀模式，“不是议会，更古老，更……本质。像是‘现实本身’在排斥他！”
林澈的意识在黑暗中沉浮。
他看到了奇异的东西，是一种抽象的感知。
他感知到自己与这个世界的“连接”正在被切断。不是物理上的离开，是存在意义上的“剥离”。就像一幅画里的人物，正在被从画布上擦除。
为什么？
他努力思考，用最后一点清醒的意识。
然后他想到了医圣的投影，想到了那个问题：“何为治愈？”
他给出了答案，一个关于平衡、关于动态、关于生命的答案。
但这个答案……可能触动了某个更深层的禁忌。
“现实……不允许……这样的答案……”林澈在意识深处喃喃。
“先生！坚持住！”赵虎的声音从遥远的地方传来。
林澈感觉到一股温暖的力量注入体内，那是赵虎的生命本源，他在用自己的存在来“锚定”林澈的存在。
但这还不够。就像用一根绳子拉住正在坠入深渊的人，绳子本身也在被拉断。
“用平衡球体！”白雨突然喊道，“那颗球体是他创造的，与他的法则本源同源！也许能稳住！”
埃塔立刻取来球体，放在林澈胸口。
灰色球体感应到林澈的状态，开始剧烈旋转，释放出强烈的平衡波动。
周围的时空出现涟漪，林澈身体的下沉速度减缓了，但没有停止。
“还是不够！”埃塔咬牙，“侵蚀的力量来自比维度更深的层面！是……‘存在性’层面的攻击！”
“那是什么鬼东西！”赵虎怒吼。
“就是‘存在’这个概念本身，”埃塔赶忙解释，“在某些高维理论中，存在不是理所当然的。它需要被‘允许’，需要符合某种‘规则’。林医官的答案，可能违反了那个规则。”
规则……
林澈在黑暗中，突然明白了。
他回想起穿越之初，回想起手术刀的来历，回想起医圣的叛逃。
医圣为什么叛逃？因为他发现了议会的“治疗”是错误的。那他发现了什么更深的东西？
也许……他发现“现实”本身就有病。
content_en:
On the third day after the medical saint's projection disappeared, an unexpected change occurred.
Early that morning, when Lin Che was studying how to apply the law of balancing spheres to the Vaccine Forest Network, she suddenly felt a severe heart palpitation. The scalpel slipped from his hand, and the blade was dull and even had slight cracks.
"Sir!" Zhao Hu rushed into the laboratory and saw Lin Che kneeling on the ground, with pale golden blood oozing from her seven orifices - this was a sign that the origin of the law was damaged.
Bai Yu and Etta followed closely behind, and were shocked when they saw this scene.
"What's going on? You were fine just now!" Bai Yu supported Lin Che and used spiritual energy to check his condition. His face instantly turned pale, "His law structure... is collapsing!"
The "law basis" that constituted Lin Che's existence was disintegrating. Like a building whose foundation suddenly turned to quicksand, the entire structure began to sink and crumble.
Etta checked it with a high-dimensional scanner, and her voice changed tone: "It's 'existence anchor point erosion'! Someone... no, there is some kind of power that is denying his 'existence rationality' from the root!"
"Parliament?" Zhao Hu's eyes widened angrily.
"No, this method..." Etta quickly analyzed the erosion pattern, "It's not the Parliament, it's older, more... essential. It's like 'reality itself' is rejecting him!"
Lin Che's consciousness was floating in the darkness.
He saw something strange, an abstract perception.
He sensed that his "connection" to the world was being severed. It's not a physical departure, it's an existential "separation". Like figures in a painting, being erased from the canvas.
Why?
He thought hard, using his last bit of conscious awareness.
Then he thought of the projection of the medical saint, and thought of the question: "What is healing?"
He gave an answer, an answer about balance, about dynamics, about life.
But this answer...may have touched a deeper taboo.
"Reality... does not allow... such an answer..." Lin Che murmured deep in her consciousness.
"Sir! Hold on!" Zhao Hu's voice came from a distant place.
Lin Che felt a warm power pouring into her body, which was Zhao Hu's life source. He was using his own existence to "anchor" Lin Che's existence.
But this is not enough. Like a rope holding a person falling into an abyss, the rope itself is being pulled.
"Use a balancing sphere!" Bai Yu suddenly shouted, "That sphere was created by him and has the same origin as his law! Maybe it can be stabilized!"
Etta immediately took the sphere and placed it on Lin Che's chest.
Sensing Lin Che's state, the gray sphere began to rotate violently, releasing strong balance fluctuations.
Ripples appeared in the surrounding space and time, and the sinking speed of Lin Che's body slowed down, but did not stop.
"It's still not enough!" Etta gritted her teeth, "The power of erosion comes from a level deeper than dimensions! It is...an attack on the 'existential' level!"
"What the hell is that!" Zhao Hu roared.
"It's the concept of 'existence' itself," Etta hurriedly explained. "In some high-dimensional theories, existence is not taken for granted. It needs to be 'allowed' and needs to comply with certain 'rules.' Doctor Lin's answer may violate that rule."
Rules…
In the darkness, Lin Che suddenly understood.
He recalled the beginning of time travel, the origin of the scalpel, and the defection of the medical saint.
Why did the medical sage defect? Because he discovered that the council's "treatment" was wrong. So what did he discover that was deeper?
Maybe...he discovered that "reality" itself is sick.
